plate.prompt:
stylized low-poly game art, in the style of the attached reference. big flat facets,
chunky bevelled shapes, flat colour planes with 2 or 3 values per colour, crisp dark
outlines. matte paint: no gloss, no reflection on any floor, no specular highlight,
no bloom. a few flat paint chips and rust patches, no noise texture. palette: cream,
teal, mustard, olive, rust, small orange lights, navy. warm key light from the upper
left, cool rim. space is near black navy with many small stars, no fog. not
photographic, not realistic, no depth of field.

outpost exchange interior, wide 16:9 plate, 2048 × 1152. orthographic cutaway at 42 degree azimuth and 29 degree elevation. rectangular raised floor, two walls at back and left, front open. left wall recedes from lower left to upper middle; back wall runs from upper middle toward right. cream walls, teal structural beams, mustard pipes and rails. back wall: a wide left recess contains the teal trade counter on the floor and a goods rack directly behind it, a calm cream wall panel in the middle, and a cargo lift inside the right opening. goods are chunky cream, olive and rust boxes strapped to shelving. the lift platform sits at floor height, entirely inside its frame. all furniture follows the same room perspective, built into its wall bay. broad uninterrupted matte dark teal-grey floor in the foreground, few large panels and flat mustard edge marks. wall panels stay calm for interface cards. a few tied bundles at edges and one repair patch. navy space around the cutaway, small stars. no planet, people, interface, text or separate furniture sprites. attached platform is the style anchor; keep its clear flat planes and simple bevels.
